To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SiPMs we have tested show good linearity (up to 100 keV), low dark noise rate, low cross-talk and good photon detection efficiency.
we have demonstrated the first SiPM fabricated in a standard silicon planar process, with good performance in terms of photon detection efficiency and dark noise rate.
we demonstrated the feasibility of the technology, that we obtained relevant results in terms of device performance, and that the device has a potential for application to PET.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel PET system based on the use of SiPMs.
the development of SiPMs with a high level of integration and a low level of crosstalk.
the development of SiPM for the application to the Positron Emisson Tomography (PET).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SiPM technology has reached maturity and can be applied to the PET field with a good degree of confidence.
the ST SiPM is a very promising technology for the development of PET detectors.
the STMicroelectronics SiPM technology is already competitive with other SiPM technologies in the market.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SiPM technology is a valid alternative to traditional photomultipliers in the field of PET imaging.
we have shown that SiPMs are a very good candidate to be used in PET applications, in particular for the development of a new generation of small animal PET scanners.
the STMicroelectronics SiPM technology is a valid and competitive alternative to other technologies already available on the market.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to produce SiPM in a standard CMOS process, with a very good performance, at a competitive cost.
it is possible to fabricate Silicon Photomultiplier in a CMOS compatible technology with performances comparable to the ones of devices fabricated in dedicated technologies.
the technology is ready to enter the production phase and to be commercialized.
